name: tn08_long_state_prior3
description: The four tn01_gpu PUMAs whose rare-race tract multipliers rest on about one sampled case (4703000, 4702300: R-hat ~1.07 on a tract nh_asian cell; 4702900: NH/PI tract cells; 4701900: a tract B26001 cell), with tn05's longer HMC: 32 chains, 500 warmup with a diagonal learned in Stan's windows, 4,000 samples kept every 40th (3,200 draws), started from screened draws of the whitening shrunk toward its mean only if too few pass (init_floor). Held-out tables scored (compare_variants.py). The statewide support at epsilon 0.01 (inputs tennessee-5t-2024-5yr-state-e0.01) with the paper baseline's Gaussian multiplier prior, sd 3 (+prior3): tn05_long_state_e0.01, which omitted the prior, corrected; the statewide baseline, to compare with tn05_long_prior3 (compare_variants.py). One PUMA per GPU bundle, 64G; run across ai-tenn-debug and campus-gpu by run_queue.py, resumed from the HMC checkpoints past each 3 h limit.
